notes: Godot 4 playable Brazilian political-satire arcade (Buraco Político): 90-second hole-growth run around a Brasília-inspired plaza, three fictional candidates, local high scores. SPDX MIT (LICENSE). Barlow / Barlow Condensed SIL OFL 1.1 (assets/fonts/OFL-Barlow.txt, OFL-BarlowCondensed.txt). PixelLab-generated portraits and props with prompts in assets/art/PROVENANCE.md; PixelLab ToS (2026-10-30) lets the author distribute outputs. Sound is synthesized in-engine (no bundled audio). Upstream game_icon.svg is original (md5 f186bc3953d5686ecabce0b377c77934); not the default Godot icon. No Git LFS, no editor .godot, no signing keystore.
